items.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: my first movie that I ever saw then was Bob Hope... I was on vacation with a friend of mine, and I got to sneak in and see it

ctx.x: But war movies were ok. [Laughs]. But my first movie that I ever saw then was Bob Hope... I was on vacation with a friend of mine, and I got to sneak in and see it, and my father never found out. So, Bob Hope and Bing Crosby, when I was fourteen.
Wow. Do you recall what that movie was?
